text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Digital has a group dance lesson today, so I've come to see how it's going.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Echo forth! Fanfare! ♪ Sprint on! Towards the goal, I race! ♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Wooo woo!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: The two of us will soon see a future full of shining stars! ♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Wowiewowiewowie! King!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: …You know, Digital, you need to do more than cheer along if you want to improve your dancing.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oh! S-sorry! I wasn't thinking. Old habits die hard!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Good grief. Well, you're up next. I'll check your performance myself.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh?! N-no way… You'll only soil your precious eyes watching me dance…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: All the more reason for me to inspect you. I have zero intention of letting someone who has taken a lesson with moi give a lackluster performance.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Gyah! King is looking out for me?! O-omigosh! I-I-I can't breathe!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I've got it! I'll learn the dance properly and do you proud on stage… at a winning concert…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Even if it kills me!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! Show me your determination!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am! Hey, Trainer. What's the best dance to show off my determination?
choice_data_list: Do the dance you're best at!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: R-right! I'll give that a shot! Cue the music and… hit it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Tra la la la la! Tra la la—huh?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Guh… If I keep struggling this much, there's no way I can show King my determination…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: No complaining! Instead, let's work on your trouble spots first!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh?! K-King! Ohh… keep it together, Digitan! Don't… smile! Not… yet!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Butbutbutbut… King is sooo nice… I already feel like… 2,000% blessed! Guehuehue! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fighting to restrain her urges, Agnes Digital gets through the group dance lesson.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I-in that case, I'll do the same choreography King was just dancing!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Echo forth! Fanfare! ♪ Sprint on! Towards the goal, I race! ♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hm?! O-oh, not too shabby…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: What?! D-d-do you mean it?! Omigosh… I can't believe I just got a compliment from King!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: A-anyway, shall we resume the lesson? …I won't let myself be one-upped.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ooohhh… King's put on her serious face! I've got to film th—no! I've got to be serious. Gotta be serious!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of them are having a positive effect on each other, and the dance lesson ends up being very productive!
